back_blocks.md: The **reactivity series **orders metals from most reactive to least reactive.

front_blocks.md: Which metals must be extracted by **electrolysis**?

back_blocks.md: Metals that must be extracted by **electrolysis **are higher up the reactivity series (above carbon) and include aluminum, sodium, potassium, calcium, lithium and magnesium.
